notes: Мокей was recorded as a new NPC; Марта was updated (she already existed). That is fine.
The guild barge crew (two people in guild jackets) were not recorded as people or as a faction presence; they only appear in a world note. Minor miss.
The «ВОДОЛАЗ» notice was not recorded as a place or a lead. It was only referenced in a world note, with invented details about Dorn.

The narration does not mention a debt of forty coins, but the Марта record says Рэй owes her 40 coins. There is no basis for it in the narration or the ledger, so it is invented; it may be prior state that I cannot see.

The notes invent the ship name «Кулик», the merchant Дорн, the smuggled crates, and the cause of the broken window. These are private DM secrets in world notes, which is permissible, but they are heavy invention beyond the narration.
Мокей's character note contains an invented cause for the patched hull (damaged at the breakwater at night).
The money facts (40 coins owed, 30 coins per crate) were captured through the debt quest, the Dorn character and the Kulik thread, not through a money change, which is correct since no money moved.
The debt description says Rey promised to repay 'when he finds work', which is close to the player's words, so it is acceptable.
People: Dorn recorded; Marta's notes updated. The guild members on the barge were recorded only inside the thread and the world note, not as a separate record, which is minor.
Places: the Kulik wreck at the breakwater is recorded through the thread's locationRefs.

Invented: the world note mentions 'красный шнур на рее; чайки обходят' and 'рассказ Мокея', which are not in this narration. They probably come from earlier turns, but they are a minor unsupported detail.
Time: 10 minutes for a short conversation is reasonable.
The plank was recorded as owned by Mokei, which matches the narration (it lies under the thwart in his boat).
The night-boat clue and the sealed plank are captured in the world note.
The two men on the guild barge are not recorded, but they are mere description and the clue note covers the guild watchers, so this is not counted as a miss.
15 minutes for a conversation is a reasonable fit.
Money: the 4 coins/day pump wage offer is recorded in the place description, character relation and world notes. No money changed hands, so this is acceptable.

Debts/promises: Braga's warning about the Kulik (answerable to the harbor warden) is recorded. The pending offer to enlist Rey on the pump from noon, with pay that evening, sits only in open_questions and not as a firm commitment. This is a minor gap, since the player has not yet accepted.
Time: 10 minutes of travel plus about 5 minutes of waiting plus conversation gives roughly 20, which matches the state.
People: the clerk is keyed as 'tikhon' although the narration gives no name. This is an invented name, but it is only an internal key and does not matter to play.
The writer's world notes (clues_kulik) repeat earlier-turn facts, which is harmless.

The narration shows no burnt-ear guildsman: only the clerk and smokers who move closer. The upsert_character for him, with his taunt and departure to report, has no basis in the narration. That is one invented record.
The plan_braga_watch_ray note and the burnt-ear dialogue are also unsupported by the narration. Both depend on the same invented character, so they count within the single invented total.
The clerk's refusal (the bargain failed, the pay stays at 4 coins) is recorded in open_questions and in the clerk's character note, so it counts as a recorded open matter.
The clerk is a person met whose standing shifted slightly, but he was not recorded as a new character, only given a note. Counted as a minor miss.
The 5 minutes recorded match the short exchange.
Missed: the wage of four coins payable at sunset was not recorded as money owed to Рэй.
Missed: the hiring (Рэй hired as pump hand, shift from noon, pay at sunset) was not recorded as a promise or quest.
Missed: Рэй's agreement to work and the pay-at-sunset promise were not recorded as a debt or promise.
Invented: note_world 'pump-sabotage' says the valve cuff was cut by Dorn's men and that Рэй found the cut. The narration shows no such discovery; Рэй only starts checking the valves.
Invented: the Савва character note (scar, speech tics, goals) and the Клим description (he teased about currents at the breakwater) have no basis in the narration.
The Рэй and Клим upserts and the Савва and Сыч records are accurate to the narration. Писарь and Брага were not recorded as characters, but they are minor.
The 15-minute move matches a short walk and look at the pump.
